column7: admin clear-login-lockout cleared the IP budget / account lockout first and wrote its audit event afterwards, so an audit fault left an unaudited lift of a brute-force refusal. Now the intent event is written first and a failed audit write clears nothing; a clear that faults after the intent event appends admin.login_lockout_clear_failed. Red on main: IP budget and account lockout were already cleared when the audit write failed.
